comments.text:
Amanda is definitely Rebecca.  I think Rebecca was killed somehow, but her soul is in Amanda. When the special tape shows Rebecca reading words given to her by the director of the show, they were the names of demons. Lots of the things she says like “I feel myself rotting, I’m out there somewhere” as in her body is rotting in the real world. And when she mentions parents, in the first tape or when she sees the “daddy chicken” she seems upset. Probably reminding her of Sam her dad. And Kate was a good friend to Sam and helped a lot with the show,so she was probably close to Rebecca. After her father went missing Kate was probably all she had left. Kate seems to get more and more important to the story. I also wonder if the letter Amanda was trying to send to her friend (Kate) was saying help. There is a theory that wooly is actually bad, her was put there to make Amanda seem evil, when she “glitches” or acts out and gets upset, I think it’s because Rebecca is in pain and doesn’t really know what happened to her, in small moments she remembers. 
Other people go way more in depth but I think this theory is true, but who knows.

comments.text: Hey man, I wanted to point out that there is a good ending or true ending and a bad ending 2. My brother played this game and I remember him talking about it earlier. I’m not exactly sure how you can get the good ending, but I’m pretty sure if you follow every one of Amanda’s directions (if I remember correctly), and get to the last tape that she has you’ll be able to decide when she asks you if you want to hear her secret. You can answer either “yes” or “no” a different ending happens depending on what you decide to answer with. I think good ending is if you say no and true if you say you do want to hear her secret. For the bad ending 2, it’s more easier because you’ve already got there. If you reply the tape “Everything Rots!” while having the pause button already put in, instead of pausing it you can skip forward to and when you press it twice when it comes up it (this happens at 26:27) will jump to 28:17 the end and instead of Amanda saying “I think it might to late” she’ll say, “that’s what I was afraid of happening.” you’ll see the skin walker Amanda and die the same way as before. Soooo, kinda no point in getting that one cause you’ll die anyway but just pointing it out. Lastly, from 8:10 to 8:24, it shows on the top of the screen a text saying “New! Blabbot! Only $1503.25!” 150325 is the code you need to put in the colorful robot. I know through tapes there are little things that impact secret tapes and other things like secrets and stuff, but great good so far! I’ll look forward to part 2!
